founder.description: My name is Catherina. It all started with one teacher and a simple idea: English comes alive the moment you speak it.

items.title: Education
items.body: A degree in English philology — and constant practice with students from A1 to C1.

items.title: 4 years of teaching
items.body: From first phrases to confident conversation: one-to-one, in mini-groups and at Speaking Club.

items.title: Exam preparation
items.body: NMT, EVI and English interviews — with a plan, clear steps and feedback after every lesson.

items.title: Why Fluyo
items.body: I built Fluyo because I kept meeting people who knew the rules but were afraid to speak. Here English is learned out loud — in conversation, without fear of mistakes.

hero.assurance: We'll assess your level and match a program to your goal.

lessons.description: Real conversation, materials built around your goal, and feedback after every lesson — all online, at your pace.

items.title: Materials built around your goal
items.body: Your plan and tasks match your level, pace, and goal.

items.title: Feedback after every lesson

qa.description: These are the questions we hear most. If yours is not here, write to us on Telegram — we answer quickly.

teachers.title: Who you will learn with
teachers.description: A small team where every teacher owns a focus — so you land with the person who leads exactly your goal.

trialPricing.title: Your consultation is free
trialPricing.description: We meet, check your level, and match the right format. The trial lesson is a full lesson, so you feel the real pace right away. After that - transparent prices with no hidden terms.

exam.summary: A path for IELTS, NMT, or school exams when the learner needs structure, deadlines, and regular progress checks.
exam.fit: Fits teens and adults preparing for a specific exam or closing weak spots before a test date.
exam.method: At the start, the teacher checks level, target score or exam format, then builds a lesson plan around writing, speaking, grammar, and task practice.
exam.diagnosticCue: The consultation works as a diagnosis: the learner sees the current point, risks, and closest next step.

kids.summary: A path for families who need a gentle start, child engagement, and parent-friendly progress signals.
kids.fit: Fits kids and teens who need regular practice without pressure, while parents get a clear view of progress.
kids.method: Lessons keep a short rhythm, speaking tasks, and a clear next step so the child speaks instead of only completing exercises.
kids.diagnosticCue: The consultation shows level, comfort with the teacher, and the format that can support regular learning.

adult.summary: A path for adults who want to speak more confidently at work, while travelling, or in everyday conversations.
adult.fit: Fits learners who have studied English before but freeze in live conversation or need practice for specific situations.
adult.method: The teacher builds speaking practice around real scenarios, corrects blockers, and gives phrases the learner can use immediately.
adult.diagnosticCue: The consultation identifies level, speaking barriers, and the format that helps progress without overload.

team.description: From our founder to every teacher on the team, each owns a focus — so you land with the person who fits your goal best from the very first lesson.

pathNotes.adult: For adults, the consultation is a real conversation: we check your level and match a speaking format.

formats.title: Choose the format that fits how you learn.
formats.description: Individual, in a pair, or in a mini-group - every format keeps a live teacher conversation and a clear plan.

individual.title: Individual
individual.fit: Adults and teens who want maximum speaking practice and a flexible schedule.
individual.terms: 60 minutes one-on-one with the teacher, with a schedule built around you.

mini-group.title: Mini-group
mini-group.fit: Kids and adults who enjoy learning in a small group: a steady pace and supportive peers.
mini-group.terms: Up to 4 learners per group, 75-minute lessons, a stable schedule, and a term plan.

packages.title: Buy a package - pay less per lesson.
packages.description: The bigger the package, the lower the price per lesson. Pick the pace that suits you.

military-family.description: For service members and students whose family members serve. Applies to all packages; a confirming document may be required.

trial-booking.question: How do I book a consultation?
trial-booking.answer: Use the Telegram CTA, and the message will carry page and language context.

format-choice.question: How do I know which format fits me?
format-choice.answer: Start with the programs page: it separates exams, kids, and adult goals.

teacher-match.question: Can I choose a teacher?
teacher-match.answer: Yes. The manager checks the learner goal, age, level, and preferred format, then suggests a teacher for that context.

pricing-policy.question: Are the website prices final?
pricing-policy.answer: Yes. Current formats and starting prices are shown on the pricing page, and the manager can help choose the right option.

payment-method.question: How do I pay for lessons?
payment-method.answer: Payment is online: once your schedule is confirmed, the manager sends payment details in Telegram.

schedule-policy.question: When are lessons available?
schedule-policy.answer: The manager offers available slots after the consultation and matches them with the chosen format.

reschedule-policy.question: What if I need to reschedule a lesson?
reschedule-policy.answer: Tell the manager at least 24 hours ahead, and the lesson moves to another convenient slot without losing your payment.

online-format.question: How do online lessons work?
online-format.answer: Lessons run in Zoom or Google Meet with an interactive board. You only need stable internet and headphones.

english-switch.question: Can I view the site in English?
english-switch.answer: Yes. Tap EN in the menu and the site switches to English right away — you stay on the same page.
